changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_DIGITS" ("DIGIT") AS SELECT 0 as digit from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 1 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 2 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 3 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 4 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 5 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 6 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 7 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 8 from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 9 from DUAL

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_NOTIFY_APPID" ("APPID") AS select DISTINCT(APP_ID) appId from TB_ASNF_DEVICES_MASTER

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_MESSAGE_STATS" ("TXNDATE", "NUM", "OS", "APPID") AS select trunc(tnl.CREATED_TS) AS TXNDATE,count(0) AS num,tnm.OS_ID AS os,tnl.APP_ID AS appId from TB_ASNF_TXN_LOG tnl,TB_ASNF_DEVICES_MASTER tnm where (tnl.NOTIF_REG_ID = tnm.NOTIF_REG_ID) group by trunc(tnl.CREATED_TS),tnm.OS_ID,tnl.APP_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_NUMBERS" ("NUMBERS") AS SELECT ones.digit + tens.digit * 10 + hundreds.digit * 100 + thousands.digit * 1000 AS numbers FROM VW_DIGITS ones, VW_DIGITS tens, VW_DIGITS hundreds, VW_DIGITS thousands

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_ACTIVE_INACTIVE_USERS" ("APP_ID", "CREATE_TS", "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE") AS SELECT t1.APP_ID, trunc(t1.CREATE_TS) as CREATE_TS, count(*) as ACTIVE , 0 INACTIVE FROM TB_ASMI_USER t1 LEFT JOIN TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN t2 ON t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID AND t2.APP_ID = t1.APP_ID WHERE t2.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND t1.USER_ACTIVE='Y' GROUP BY t1.APP_ID, trunc(t1.CREATE_TS) UNION ALL SELECT t1.APP_ID,trunc(t1.CREATE_TS) as CREATE_TS, 0 ACTIVE, count(*) as INACTIVE FROM TB_ASMI_USER t1 LEFT JOIN TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN t2 ON t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID AND t2.APP_ID = t1.APP_ID WHERE t2.USER_ID IS NULL AND t1.USER_ACTIVE='Y' GROUP BY t1.APP_ID, trunc(t1.CREATE_TS)

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_ACTIVE_SESSIONS" ("OS", "APP_ID", "COUNT") AS SELECT B.OS, A.APP_ID, COUNT(*) as COUNT FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A,TB_ASMI_DEVICE_MASTER B WHERE A.APP_ID =B.APP_ID AND A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND time_diff (A.LAST_REQ_TIME, SYSTIMESTAMP) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE A.APP_ID=C.APP_ID ) GROUP BY B.OS, A.APP_ID UNION ALL SELECT A.DEVICE_ID,A.APP_ID, COUNT(*) as COUNT FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A WHERE A.DEVICE_ID IN ('WEB','SIMULATOR') AND A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND time_diff (A.LAST_REQ_TIME, SYSTIMESTAMP) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE A.APP_ID=C.APP_ID ) GROUP BY A.DEVICE_ID, A.APP_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_LOCATION_DETAILS" ("USER_ID", "APP_ID", "DEVICE_ID", "REQUEST_KEY", "SESSION_ID", "LAST_REQ_TIME", "LOGIN_TIME", "CREATE_TS", "VERSION_NO", "OTP", "OTP_GENERATION_TIME", "OTP_STATUS", "OTP_VALIDATION_COUNT", "LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE", "SUBLOCALITY", "ADMIN_AREA_LVL_1", "ADMIN_AREA_LVL_2", "COUNTRY", "FORMATTED_ADDRESS", "ORIGINATION") AS SELECT "USER_ID","APP_ID","DEVICE_ID","REQUEST_KEY","SESSION_ID","LAST_REQ_TIME","LOGIN_TIME","CREATE_TS","VERSION_NO","OTP","OTP_GENERATION_TIME","OTP_STATUS","OTP_VALIDATION_COUNT","LONGITUDE","LATITUDE","SUBLOCALITY","ADMIN_AREA_LVL_1","ADMIN_AREA_LVL_2","COUNTRY","FORMATTED_ADDRESS","ORIGINATION" FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A where A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND time_diff(A.LAST_REQ_TIME, SYSTIMESTAMP) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE A.APP_ID=C.APP_ID )

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_LOGIN_REPORT" ("APP_ID", "DEVICE_ID", "ACCESSDATE", "TOTALTXNS", "LOGINS", "DISTINCTLOGINS") AS SELECT tb.APP_ID,tb.DEVICE_ID,trunc(tb.CREATE_TS) as AccessDate,count(*) as TotalTxns,0 Logins,0 DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb WHERE tb.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb.APP_ID,tb.DEVICE_ID,trunc(tb.CREATE_TS) UNION ALL SELECT tb2.APP_ID,tb2.DEVICE_ID,trunc(tb2.CREATE_TS) as AccessDate,0 TotalTxns,count(*) as Logins, count(distinct trunc(tb2.CREATE_TS)) as DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb2 WHERE (tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonReLoginRequest' OR tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonAuthenticationRequest') AND tb2.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb2.APP_ID,tb2.USER_ID,tb2.DEVICE_ID,trunc(tb2.CREATE_TS)

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_CUSTOMER_DETAILS" ("APP_ID", "USER_ID", "ACCESSDATE", "SESSION_ID", "ST_TM", "END_TM", "TOTALTXNS", "DISTINCTTXNS", "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "FORMATTED_ADDRESS") AS SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,trunc(CREATE_TS) AS AccessDate,SESSION_ID,min(ST_TM) as ST_TM,max(END_TM) as END_TM,Count(*) As TotalTxns,0 DistinctTxns,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb WHERE TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY APP_ID,USER_ID,trunc(CREATE_TS),SESSION_ID,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS Union ALL SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,trunc(CREATE_TS) AS AccessDate,SESSION_ID,min(ST_TM) as ST_TM,max(END_TM) as END_TM,0 TotalTxns, Count(distinct(INTERFACE_ID)) AS DistinctTxns,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL WHERE TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY APP_ID,USER_ID,trunc(CREATE_TS),SESSION_ID,INTERFACE_ID,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_CUSTOMER_REPORT" ("APP_ID", "USER_ID", "SESSION_ID", "TM", "TOTALTXNS", "DISTINCTTXNS", "LOGINS", "DISTINCTLOGINS") AS SELECT tb.APP_ID,tb.USER_ID,tb.SESSION_ID, time_diff_milliSecs(MIN(ST_TM),MAX(END_TM)) tm, count(*) as TotalTxns,count(distinct(tb.INTERFACE_ID)) as DistinctTxns, 0 Logins,0 DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb WHERE tb.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb.APP_ID, tb.USER_ID,tb.SESSION_ID UNION ALL SELECT tb2.APP_ID,tb2.USER_ID, null SESSION_ID, null tm,0 TotalTxns,0 DistinctTxns,count(*) as Logins, count(distinct trunc(tb2.CREATE_TS)) as DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb2 WHERE (tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonReLoginRequest' OR tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonAuthenticationRequest') and tb2.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb2.APP_ID, tb2.USER_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_LAT_LON_DETAILS" ("APP_ID", "USER_ID", "COUNT_LON", "LONGITUDE", "COUNT_LAT", "LATITUDE", "FORMATTED_ADDRESS") AS SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,COUNT(LONGITUDE) as COUNT_LON, LONGITUDE, COUNT(LATITUDE) as COUNT_LAT,LATITUDE, FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL GROUP BY LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, FORMATTED_ADDRESS, APP_ID, USER_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_TXN_APP_USAGE" ("APP_ID", "ACCESSDATE", "DESCRIPTION", "TXN_STAT", "MINTIME", "MAXTIME", "AVGTIME", "INTFCOUNT") AS SELECT txn.APP_ID,trunc(txn.CREATE_TS) AS AccessDate,intf.DESCRIPTION, txn.TXN_STAT, MIN(time_diff_milliSecs(txn.ST_TM,txn.END_TM)) AS MinTime, MAX(time_diff_milliSecs(txn.ST_TM,txn.END_TM)) AS MaxTime, AVG(time_diff_milliSecs(txn.ST_TM,txn.END_TM)) AS AvgTime, count(txn.INTERFACE_ID) AS IntfCount FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL txn,TB_ASMI_INTF_MASTER intf WHERE txn.INTERFACE_ID = intf.INTERFACE_ID GROUP BY txn.APP_ID,txn.INTERFACE_ID,trunc(txn.CREATE_TS),intf.DESCRIPTION,txn.TXN_STAT

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS" ("APP_ID", "DEVICE_GROUP_ID", "DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION", "OS", "HEIGHT", "WIDTH", "ORIENTATION") AS SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, 'PORTRAIT' AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK = 'ANY' UNION ALL SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, 'LANDSCAPE' AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK = 'ANY' UNION ALL SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, ORIENTATION_LOCK AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK != 'ANY'

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_ASMI_MICROAPPS" ("APP_ID", "SCREEN_ID", "MICRO_APP_ID", "MICRO_APP_NAME", "MICRO_APP_ICON", "MICRO_APP_TYPE") AS SELECT T2.APP_ID AS APP_ID, T2.SCREEN_ID, T2.MICRO_APP_ID AS MICRO_APP_ID, T1.APP_NAME AS MICRO_APP_NAME, T1.APP_ICON AS MICRO_APP_ICON, T1.MICRO_APP_TYPE AS MICRO_APP_TYPE FROM TB_ASMI_APP_MASTER T1, TB_ASMI_SCREEN_MICRO_APP T2 WHERE T1.APP_ID = T2.MICRO_APP_ID AND T1.BASE_APP = 'N'

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_ASMI_NANOAPPS" ("APP_ID", "SCREEN_ID", "CALLFORM_ID", "CALLFORM_NAME", "CALLFORM_ICON") AS SELECT T1.APP_ID, T2.SCREEN_ID, T1.SCREEN_ID AS CALLFORM_ID, T1.SCREEN_NAME AS CALLFORM_NAME, T1.SCREEN_ICON AS CALLFORM_ICON FROM TB_ASMI_SCR_MASTER T1, TB_ASMI_SCREEN_WIDGETS T2 WHERE T1.APP_ID = T2.APP_ID AND T1.SCREEN_ID = T2.CALLFORM_ID AND T1.SCREEN_TYPE = 'CALL'

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_DATES" ("DATES") AS SELECT CURRENT_DATE - numbers AS dates FROM VW_NUMBERS

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_OS_DATES" ("OSDATES", "DATESOS", "APPID") AS select trunc(d.dates) osdates,OS_ID AS datesos,appId from VW_DATES d,TB_OS o,VW_NOTIFY_APPID ap

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "VW_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_STATS" ("APPID", "OSDATES", "COUNT", "DATESOS") AS SELECT VW_OS_DATES.appId,osdates,COALESCE(num,0) count,datesos FROM VW_MESSAGE_STATS RIGHT OUTER JOIN VW_OS_DATES ON osdates=TXNDATE AND datesos=os and VW_OS_DATES.appId=VW_MESSAGE_STATS.appId
